The USMNT’s 3-0 victory over Mexico is the team’s third consecutive win at the start of the new cycle following FIFA World Cup 2026. All three of the USA’s victories have featured at least three goals with three different goal scorers and two of the matches had four different goal scorers. The most recent victory ended a streak in which Mexico had scored in 11 straight matches and 15 of the last 16. Saturday’s win against Mexico is also the USMNT’s first victory against a FIFA/Coca-Cola top-10 opponent since Nov. 12, 2021, in a 2-0 victory against then ninth-ranked Mexico. The U.S. ended 2025 with a three-game winning streak against Australia, Paraguay and Uruguay and begin the new cycle with three victories against Peru, Chile and Mexico.
